cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per TOI, citing the Enforcement Directorate: multiple mule accounts at the Jubilee Hills Mercantile Cooperative Bank were allegedly used to route money from illegal online betting and cyber fraud (All Panel Exchange, APX). Funds then moved to shell entities and to a nodal account at Nagarbhavi Credit Cooperative Society, Bengaluru, run for Armstrong Exchange, set up by accused Sagar Dash. ED arrested Dash on Oct 27 under the PMLA; a Mumbai court gave three days' ED custody. Searches in Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Surat and Mehsana froze about ₹9 crore. ED earlier arrested Edsom Fintech CEO Ram U Ramdhani. These are ED's allegations; the bank's response was not in the report.

cards.q: Mule accounts: who should answer first?

opts: An account used to pass on illegal money
cards.why: Mule accounts receive and forward illicit funds, often in someone else's name.
